observation.visible_scene: A night fireworks display over a calm, dark body of water. A distant shoreline with scattered city lights and a single slender tower sits on the horizon; faint angled searchlight beams appear on the left. The camera is static throughout (shoreline, tower, and beams hold fixed positions), so all apparent motion is from the fireworks themselves and their mirror reflections on the water.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-2) two dotted light clusters hang in the upper sky: a left loop/heart-like shape and a right shape, both made of purple and green points, each mirrored in the water below.
Frames 3-6: small orange points emerge along the lower edges of both clusters, and the green/purple dotted outlines begin to thin.
Frames 7-13: the orange points multiply into a horizontal row of small radial starbursts while the original dotted outlines fade to faint purple arcs overhead.
Frames 14-23: the starbursts consolidate into a horizontal row of about six purple circular 'wheel' patterns; the orange bursts dim and the water reflection turns predominantly purple.
Frames 24-31: gold/orange spherical bursts ignite above the purple wheel row, one near the left and one near the right, growing in size.

Frames 32-41: those gold bursts expand into large chrysanthemum-like spheres (left, center, and a bigger right one) while the purple wheel row persists beneath them; the water reflection shifts to include gold/orange streaks matching the new blooms.
Throughout, the bright patterns in the lower half are reflections of the sky fireworks, not separate objects, and they change color in step with the bursts above.
outside_clip_unknowns: What produced the initial dotted outline shapes and their precise intended form before the crop.
How the gold chrysanthemum bursts fade or what further bursts follow after the last frame.
The full duration and sequence of the display outside this excerpt.
uncertain_details: The exact symbolic shapes intended by the early dotted clusters (heart/letter forms are inferred only from point arrangement).
Whether the left searchlight beams move at all; they appear essentially static against the dark sky.
